644: "人性之善也，犹水之就下也。人无有不善，水无有不下。"孟子以四端说（恻隐、羞恶、辞让、是非之心）论证人性本善，性善论是一切道德修养和政治治理的形上根基。恻隐之心仁之端，羞恶之心义之端，辞让之心礼之端，是非之心智之端。
识别人性中的四端萌芽（恻隐、羞恶、辞让、是非）->确认性善为形上本体根基，非由外铄我固有之->通过'扩而充之'的修养工夫发展四端->将性善论推演为政治治理原则（仁政王道）
道德教育理论中潜能开发理念,积极心理学对人性的乐观假设,人权理论基础（人人具有内在尊严和价值）
645: "我善养吾浩然之气。其为气也，至大至刚，以直养而无害，则塞于天地之间。"通过长期积累正义行为培育至大至刚的浩然之气，以坚定意志统摄精气，实现儒家内向超越的核心实践路径。配义与道，集义所生，非义袭而取之也。持其志，无暴其气。
持续积累正义行为（集义）->培育浩然之气至大至刚->以持志统摄精气，不暴其气->实现内在超越的道德人格
领导力品格建设中的长期修养工夫,心理韧性训练（resilience building）,道德勇气培养
646: "以不忍人之心，行不忍人之政。"将性善论推演为政治哲学，通过制民之产、省刑罚薄税实现王道政治，以德服人而非以力服人。得天下有道：得其民，斯得天下矣。
确认人性本善（M644）为政治前提->将性善推演为政治原则——不忍人之心->设计制度保障人民基本生活（制民之产）->省刑罚薄税，以德服人实现王道政治
公共政策设计中的民本导向,社会福利制度框架,良政善治（good governance）理念
647: "执中无权，犹执一也。所恶执一者，为其贼道也，举一而废百也。"在坚持基本原则（经）的前提下承认特殊情境的灵活变通（权），如'男女授受不亲，礼也；嫂溺援之以手者，权也。'避免教条主义导致的更大伤害。
确立基本原则（经/常道）->识别特殊情境的特殊性和时宜性->在坚持原则前提下灵活变通（权）->避免教条主义导致的更大伤害
伦理决策中的原则与情境权衡,危机管理中的灵活应变策略,领导力判断力培养
648: "行有不得者皆反求诸己，其身正而天下归之。"当行为未达预期效果时不怨天尤人，从自身找原因并通过自我修正实现改进。仁者如射：射者正己而后发；发而不中，不怨胜己者，反求诸己而已矣。
行动未达预期效果时不怨天尤人->从自身找原因（反求诸己）->通过自我修正实现改进->身正而天下归之
个人成长思维（将失败视为学习机会）,质量管理中的根因分析（RCA）,批评与自我批评的组织文化
649: "我知言。诐知其所蔽，淫知其所陷，邪知其所离，遁知其所穷。"提出辨别四种错误言论：诐辞（偏颇）、淫辞（夸大）、邪辞（邪恶）、遁辞（逃避），通过语言分析透视思想本质，捍卫儒家道统。
识别语言中的偏颇、夸大、邪恶、逃避四种错误形式->透视言论背后的思想立场和利益动机->捍卫正确道统，批判错误思潮
批判性思维训练（识别逻辑谬误和修辞操纵）,公共舆论分析与话语分析,意识形态辨析
650: "民为贵，社稷次之，君为轻。"将政治合法性根基从君主转移到人民，当君主危害人民时可以被推翻（一夫纣），是中国古代最激进的政治平等主义宣言。天视自我民视，天听自我民听。
确立人民为政治最高价值（民为贵）->推导君主合法性来自人民授权->当统治者危害人民时丧失合法性（一夫纣）->革命推翻暴政具有道德正当性
民主理论基础（东方民本传统与西方民主的对话）,政治合法性评估框架,社会正义理论中的分配正义

Inherent goodness theory is the metaphysical foundation for all moral cultivation and political governance.

确认性善为形上本体根基，非由外铄我固有之
通过'扩而充之'的修养工夫发展四端
将性善论推演为政治治理原则（仁政王道）
modern_applications: 道德教育理论中潜能开发理念
积极心理学对人性的乐观假设
人权理论基础（人人具有内在尊严和价值）

M-645.name_en: Cultivating Qi and Holding Will Method (Hao-Ran Zhi Qi)
M-645.definition_zh: "我善养吾浩然之气。其为气也，至大至刚，以直养而无害，则塞于天地之间。"通过长期积累正义行为培育至大至刚的浩然之气，以坚定意志统摄精气，实现儒家内向超越的核心实践路径。配义与道，集义所生，非义袭而取之也。持其志，无暴其气。
M-645.definition_en: "I am good at cultivating my vast flow qi. As this qi, it is the greatest and most strenuous; if nurtured directly without harm, it fills between heaven and earth." Through long-term accumulation of righteous actions, cultivate the vast flow qi (greatest and most strenuous), with firm will controlling vital energy — the core practice path of Confucian inward transcendence.
process: 持续积累正义行为（集义）
培育浩然之气至大至刚
以持志统摄精气，不暴其气
实现内在超越的道德人格
modern_applications: 领导力品格建设中的长期修养工夫

M-646.name_en: Benevolent Governance and Kingly Way Method (Ren-Zheng Wang-Dao)
M-646.definition_zh: "以不忍人之心，行不忍人之政。"将性善论推演为政治哲学，通过制民之产、省刑罚薄税实现王道政治，以德服人而非以力服人。得天下有道：得其民，斯得天下矣。
M-646.definition_en: "With the heart of compassion that cannot bear to see others' suffering, practice governance that cannot bear to cause suffering." Deduce political philosophy from inherent goodness theory, achieve kingly way through ensuring people's livelihood, reducing punishments and lightening taxes — win hearts by virtue rather than force.
process: 确认人性本善（M644）为政治前提
将性善推演为政治原则——不忍人之心
设计制度保障人民基本生活（制民之产）
省刑罚薄税，以德服人实现王道政治
modern_applications: 公共政策设计中的民本导向

M-647.definition_zh: "执中无权，犹执一也。所恶执一者，为其贼道也，举一而废百也。"在坚持基本原则（经）的前提下承认特殊情境的灵活变通（权），如'男女授受不亲，礼也；嫂溺援之以手者，权也。'避免教条主义导致的更大伤害。
M-647.definition_en: "Holding the mean without flexibility is like holding to one thing. What is detested about holding to one thing is that it harms the Way, grasping one and abandoning a hundred." Acknowledge flexible adaptation (Quan) in special circumstances while adhering to basic principles (Jing), such as 'men and women should not hand things directly — this is Li; but rescuing a drowning sister-in-law by hand is Quan.'
process: 确立基本原则（经/常道）
识别特殊情境的特殊性和时宜性
在坚持原则前提下灵活变通（权）
避免教条主义导致的更大伤害
modern_applications: 伦理决策中的原则与情境权衡
危机管理中的灵活应变策略

M-648.definition_zh: "行有不得者皆反求诸己，其身正而天下归之。"当行为未达预期效果时不怨天尤人，从自身找原因并通过自我修正实现改进。仁者如射：射者正己而后发；发而不中，不怨胜己者，反求诸己而已矣。
M-648.definition_en: "When actions do not achieve expected results, seek causes within oneself. When one's own character is upright, the world turns to him." When actions fail, do not blame heaven or others but seek causes within oneself and improve through self-correction. The benevolent one is like an archer: correct himself before shooting; if not hitting, do not envy higher scorers but seek causes within oneself.
process: 行动未达预期效果时不怨天尤人
从自身找原因（反求诸己）
通过自我修正实现改进
身正而天下归之
modern_applications: 个人成长思维（将失败视为学习机会）
质量管理中的根因分析（RCA）
批评与自我批评的组织文化

M-649.definition_zh: "我知言。诐知其所蔽，淫知其所陷，邪知其所离，遁知其所穷。"提出辨别四种错误言论：诐辞（偏颇）、淫辞（夸大）、邪辞（邪恶）、遁辞（逃避），通过语言分析透视思想本质，捍卫儒家道统。
M-649.definition_en: "I know words. I recognize biased speech by what conceals it, exaggerated speech by where it traps, evil speech by how it deviates, evasive speech by where it exhausts." Proposes distinguishing four types of erroneous speech: biased (obscured), exaggerated (trapped), evil (deviated), evasive (exhausted). Use language analysis to penetrate the essence of thoughts and defend Confucian orthodoxy.
process: 识别语言中的偏颇、夸大、邪恶、逃避四种错误形式
透视言论背后的思想立场和利益动机
捍卫正确道统，批判错误思潮
modern_applications: 批判性思维训练（识别逻辑谬误和修辞操纵）
公共舆论分析与话语分析

M-650.definition_zh: "民为贵，社稷次之，君为轻。"将政治合法性根基从君主转移到人民，当君主危害人民时可以被推翻（一夫纣），是中国古代最激进的政治平等主义宣言。天视自我民视，天听自我民听。
M-650.definition_en: "People are paramount, the state is secondary, the ruler is lightest." Transfer political legitimacy from ruler to people — when a ruler harms the people, he can be overthrown (one man Zhou). This is the most radical political egalitarian statement in ancient China. Heaven sees as the people see; heaven hears as the people hear.
process: 确立人民为政治最高价值（民为贵）
推导君主合法性来自人民授权
当统治者危害人民时丧失合法性（一夫纣）
革命推翻暴政具有道德正当性
modern_applications: 民主理论基础（东方民本传统与西方民主的对话）
社会正义理论中的分配正义

H-KZ-001.source_chapter: 《论语·卫灵公》《论语·里仁》《论语·颜渊》
H-KZ-001.definition_zh: 以自身仁爱为起点，通过'己所不欲，勿施于人'的恕道原则，建立普遍的道德实践体系。仁是内在的道德情感，恕是推己及人的方法，二者构成伦理体系的核心。孔子的仁爱并非无差等的兼爱，而是以血缘亲情为起点，由近及远、推己及人的差等之爱。
H-KZ-001.definition_en: Starting from personal benevolence, through the principle of 'Do not do unto others what you would not want done to yourself' (Shu), establish a universal moral practice system. Ren is the internal moral feeling, Shu is the method of extending oneself to others; together they form the core of the ethical system. Confucius' Ren-Ai is not impartial love like Mohism, but graded love starting from family ties and extending outward.
process: 反思自身的感受和欲望
将心比心，理解他人立场
己所不欲勿施于人，己欲立而立人
通过推己及人实现人际和谐

H-KZ-001.definition_zh: 通过确立社会角色的名分与责任，使名实相符，建立有序的社会结构。'名不正则言不顺，言不顺则事不成'是政治秩序的逻辑起点。正名的逻辑链条：名不正→言不顺→事不成→礼乐不兴→刑罚不中→民无所措手足。正名不仅是对名实的语言要求，更是对社会角色的规范——君要像君，臣要像臣，父要像父，子要像子。
H-KZ-001.definition_en: By establishing the names and responsibilities of social roles, making names correspond to reality, build an ordered social structure. 'When names are not correct, language is not in accordance with truth; when language is not in accordance with truth, affairs cannot be carried on' is the logical starting point of political order. The logic chain: incorrect names → incoherent speech → failed affairs → rites and music falter → punishments misplaced → people at a loss. Rectification of names is not merely linguistic but normative for social roles.
process: 明确各社会角色的名分和定位
界定相应角色的责任和权利
使名实相符，言行一致
通过正名建立社会秩序

H-KZ-001.definition_zh: 执其两端，用其中于民。无过无不及，恰到好处。中庸不是简单的折中主义，而是在具体情境中寻找恰当平衡点的实践智慧。'中庸之为德也，其至矣乎！民鲜久矣'将中庸誉为最高德行。中庸包含两个维度：一是'执两用中'，即把握事物的两个极端，找到中间的恰当位置；二是'时中'，即根据时势变化灵活调整。
H-KZ-001.definition_en: Grasp both extremes and apply the mean to the people. Neither excessive nor deficient, but just right. The Doctrine of the Mean is not simple compromise — compromise mechanically takes a middle value, while Zhong-Yong finds the appropriate balance point in concrete situations. 'The Doctrine of the Mean must be a virtue!' It contains two dimensions: (1) grasping both extremes to find the appropriate middle, and (2) Shi-Zhong — adjusting flexibly according to changing circumstances.
process: 识别情境中的两个极端倾向
判断过与不及的具体表现
在两端之间寻找恰当的平衡点
根据情境灵活调整，保持动态平衡

H-KZ-001.definition_zh: 视其所以，观其所由，察其所安。根据学生个性、能力、兴趣差异进行针对性教学，实现最大化教育效果。这是中国教育学史上最早的个性化教育理论。孔子提出'中人以上，可以语上也；中人以下，不可以语上也'，强调教学内容应根据学生水平调整。还提出'不愤不启，不悱不发'的启发式教学原则。
H-KZ-001.definition_en: Observe what a person does, consider the motive, examine where they find contentment. Teach according to individual differences in personality, ability, and interest to achieve maximum educational effectiveness. This is the earliest personalized education theory in Chinese educational history. Confucius stated 'Above average, one may be taught advanced matters; below average, one may not' and proposed heuristic teaching principles of 'do not open until the student struggles, do not clarify until the student stumbles'.
process: 了解学生的个性特点和学习需求
分析学生已有的知识基础和能力水平
设计针对性的教学内容和方式
因势利导，启发学生自主学习

H-KZ-001.definition_zh: 学而不思则罔，思而不学则殆。将学习与思考有机结合，实现认知螺旋上升，是儒家认识论的核心。孔子自述'发愤忘食，乐以忘忧，不知老之将至'，体现了学思合一的终身学习态度。既反对教条主义（只学不思），也反对经验主义（只思不学）。
H-KZ-001.definition_en: 'Learning without thought is labor lost; thought without learning is perilous.' Integrate learning and thinking organically to achieve spiral cognitive ascent — this is the core of Confucian epistemology. Confucius described 'studying until forgetting food, rejoicing until forgetting sorrow, not knowing old age is coming', embodying lifelong learning-unity. It opposes both dogmatism (learning without thinking) and empiricism (thinking without learning).
process: 广泛学习前人知识和经验
深度思考知识的内在逻辑
将所学与所思相互印证
在学思互动中实现认知跃迁

H-KZ-001.definition_zh: 兴于诗，立于礼，成于乐。通过诗、礼、乐的完整路径实现人格的全面发展和文化认同。孔子评价韶乐'尽美矣，又尽善也'，而武乐'尽美矣，未尽善也'，体现了对艺术道德功能的重视。礼乐教化的核心功能是将外在规范内化为道德自觉，通过文化的熏陶实现人格的全面发展。
H-KZ-001.definition_en: 'Awakened by Poetry, established by Rites, completed by Music.' Through the complete path of Poetry, Rites, and Music, achieve comprehensive personality development and cultural identity. Confucius evaluated Shao music as 'fully beautiful and fully good', while Wu music as 'fully beautiful but not fully good'. The core function is transforming external norms into moral consciousness through cultural edification.
process: 通过诗歌激发情感共鸣
通过礼仪确立行为规范
通过音乐实现人格圆满
在三者统一中完成道德内化

H-KZ-001.definition_zh: 以君子为理想人格，通过持续修养实现道德完善。君子坦荡荡，小人长戚戚；君子喻于义，小人喻于利；君子欲讷言而敏行；君子固穷，小人穷斯滥矣。君子不是身份标识，而是道德理想——任何人都可以通过修养达到君子境界。
H-KZ-001.definition_en: Taking the Junzi (gentleman) as ideal character, achieving moral perfection through continuous self-cultivation. 'The Junzi is open and at ease, the petty man always anxious'; 'The Junzi understands righteousness, the petty man understands profit'. The Junzi is not an identity marker but a moral ideal — anyone can reach the Junzi state through cultivation.
process: 确立君子人格为追求目标
在义利之间选择道义
通过日常修养积累德性
在困境中坚守原则不动摇

H-KZ-001.definition_zh: 无可无不可。在坚持原则的前提下根据具体情况采取适当方法，实现灵活应变，是经权统一的决策智慧。孟子评价孔子'可以仕则仕，可以止则止，可以久则久，可以速则速'，正是时中权变的精髓。经权结合是关键——经是常道，权是变通。
H-KZ-001.definition_en: 'No fixed course of action.' Under the premise of adhering to principles, adopt appropriate methods according to specific situations. Mencius evaluated Confucius as 'serving when he could, retiring when he should, staying long or departing swiftly' — the essence of contextual flexibility. Jing-Quan unity is key: Jing is constancy, Quan is adaptability.
process: 识别当前情境的特殊性和时宜性
理解常规原则（经）与变通（权）的边界
根据具体条件灵活调整策略
在变化中保持原则的灵活性

H-KZ-001.definition_zh: 温故而知新，可以为师矣。通过复习旧知识获得新理解，实现知识的创新应用和迁移。强调知识的连续性和可迁移性。温故知新的操作要点是：系统回顾已有知识、在新情境中发现旧知识的新意义、通过联想和类比实现知识迁移。与'举一反三'密切相关——通过一个例子理解一类问题。
H-KZ-001.definition_en: 'Reviewing the old to understand the new — such a person can be a teacher.' Through reviewing past knowledge, gain new understanding and achieve innovative application and transfer. Key operational points: systematically review existing knowledge, discover new meanings of old knowledge in novel contexts, achieve knowledge transfer through association and analogy. Closely related to 'infer one of three' — understanding a category of problems through one example.
process: 系统回顾和梳理已有知识经验
在新情境中发现旧知识的新意义
通过联想和类比实现知识迁移
将新知识融入已有认知体系

H-KZ-001.definition_zh: 见贤思齐焉，见不贤而内自省也。以他人为镜，不断自我完善，是持续成长的实践方法。将所有人（包括反面人物）都转化为学习资源，体现了全面学习的智慧。孔子强调'吾日三省吾身'，将自省作为日常修行。
H-KZ-001.definition_en: 'When you see a worthy person, think of equaling them; when you see an unworthy person, reflect on yourself.' Use others as mirrors for continuous self-improvement — this is the practical method for sustained growth. Transforming all people (including反面 figures) into learning resources embodies comprehensive learning wisdom. Confucius emphasized 'I examine myself three times daily', making self-reflection a daily practice.
process: 识别身边的榜样和反面教材
向优秀者学习，反思不足处
制定改进计划并付诸实践
形成持续自我完善的习惯

modes.definition_zh: 将'天下为主，君为客'作为政治合法性的根本原则，认为天下的主体是万民而非君主。此法颠覆了传统'家天下'观念，将君主定位为天下的服务者而非所有者。在《原君》篇中，黄宗羲指出古之君主'以天下利禄尽付之人，出其身而天下受其享'，而后世君主'以天下利害之权皆出于我'。此法通过重新定义君民关系，构建了以万民福祉为核心的政治伦理框架。
process: 识别传统'家天下'观念的谬误
确立万民为天下主体的政治伦理
将君主重新定位为服务者而非所有者
以万民之忧乐作为治乱评判标准

modes.definition_zh: 明确提出'有治法而后有治人'的命题，与荀子'有治人无治法'相对立。此法认为良法是好人施展才能的前提，没有好的制度，再贤能的人也会被束缚。黄宗羲区分了'天下之法'与'一家之法'，指出三代以上的法是为公的（天下之法），三代以下的法是为私的（一家之法）。此法将制度置于个人德行之上，是中国古代罕见的法治优先论。
process: 批判'有治人无治法'的人治观念
区分天下之法（为公）与一家之法（为私）
论证良法是先王恻隐爱人精神的制度化表达
通过制度设计约束权力，使即使坏人执政也不致造成最坏后果

modes.definition_zh: '三代以上有法，三代以下无法'——此法不是指三代之后没有法律条文，而是指那些制度都是'非法之法'（为私的法）。黄宗羲借用《老子》'无法之法'的概念，描述三代以上'藏天下于天下'的疏朗制度：山泽之利不必尽取，刑赏之权不疑旁落。这种'法愈疏而乱不作'的境界正是'无法之法'的体现。相比之下，后世'藏天下于筐箧'，法愈密而乱愈生。此法通过'疏/密'二元分析框架，揭示制度设计的实质效果与表面严密的悖论关系。
process: 识别'有法/无法'不是有无条文而是正当性之分
理解'藏天下于天下'（为公）与'藏天下于筐箧'（为私）的二元对立
分析法之疏密与实际治乱的逆向关系
追求'法愈疏而乱不作'的制度境界
modern_applications: 制度设计中的'少即是多'

modes.definition_zh: 黄宗羲运用一系列二元概念（一家之法/天下之法、国家/天下、君主/万民、一姓/群工）构建公私辩证体系。其核心洞见是：'万民之私'就是'天下之大公'。在《原君》篇中，他肯定每个人追求自身利益的正当性（'各得自私，各得自利'），将所有人的私集合起来就是天下之公。此法颠覆了传统将'公/私'视为零和博弈的观念，提出了一种前现代的功利主义公共性理论。
process: 识别传统公私对立观念的局限
肯定个人追求自身利益的正当性
理解万民之私的集合构成天下之大公
以公私辩证法重构政治正当性基础

modes.definition_zh: 在《学校》篇中，黄宗羲设计了独特的制度：将学校从单纯的教育机构提升为政治议政和监督机构。'学校，所以养士也。然凡有政事，莫不造于书院，参决于天子'。中央太学祭酒由大儒担任，其地位与宰相等同；地方学校定期集会评议朝政。此法通过学术共同体来制约政治权力，是中国古代最接近近代议会制度的设计。学校不仅是知识传播场所，更是'公其是非于学校'的政治决策机构。
process: 识别学校作为政治机构的独特功能
设计中央与地方学校的层级议政体系
确立学术共同体对政治决策的参政权和否决权
通过知识权威制约王权

modes.definition_zh: 在《置相》篇中，黄宗羲设计了恢复宰相制度的方案，并辅以学校议政来形成权力制衡。他认为'有明之无善治，自高皇帝罢丞相也'，恢复宰相可以分君权、防专断。同时，他设计了取士制度的多维渠道（科举之外还有荐举、太学、辟召等），以及田制、兵制、财计等方面的系统性改革方案。此法通过制度层面的分权设计来限制君主专断，体现了深刻的政治智慧。
process: 诊断专制制度的根本缺陷（罢丞相）
设计宰相制度以分君权
建立学校对政治的监督和制约机制
在田制、兵制、财计各层面设计系统性改革

modes.definition_zh: 黄宗羲的经世致用不同于顾炎武的考据路径，也不同于王夫之的形上建构。他的经世致用体现在《明夷待访录》对现实政治问题的系统性解决方案中：田制三篇讨论土地分配，兵制三篇讨论军事改革，财计三篇讨论财政制度。此法强调从具体制度和政策层面解决社会问题，而非空谈心性或沉溺考据。其核心是'融心性与事功为一体'，在制度上多有非凡阐发和设计。
process: 诊断具体社会政治问题（土地兼并、军事积弊、财政困窘）
从历史经验中寻找制度参照（三代封建之治）
设计系统性政策方案（田制、兵制、财计各三篇）
在实践层面推动制度变革

modes.name_zh: 史学方法论（明末清初版）
modes.definition_zh: 黄宗羲毕生致力于学术史整理，编撰《宋元学案》（未完成）和众多别集序跋。其史学方法论强调'以史证经、以经观史'，通过梳理学术源流来理解思想演变。他开创了学案体史学，以学派为纲、人物为目，系统整理宋元学术思想。此法不仅是史学编纂方法，更是通过历史梳理来寻找现实变革资源的思想方法——'读《待访录》，知百王之弊可以复振'（顾炎武语）。
process: 梳理学术思想的历史源流与演变
以学派为纲、人物为目组织史料
从历史经验中寻找现实变革的资源
通过学术史整理为当代问题提供参照
modern_applications: 历史经验与现代问题的对话

modes.definition_zh: 黄宗羲在儒家框架内进行批判性重构，既不完全否定传统，也不盲从权威。他从《孟子》'民贵君轻'和《礼运》'天下为公'出发，创造出'天下为主''万民之忧乐'等全新概念。这种批判继承不同于后来冯友兰提出的'抽象继承法'，而是在具体历史语境中重新诠释经典。他既肯定君主制度的必要性（不像后来革命派主张彻底废除），又通过制度设计将其权力严格限制在服务万民的范围内。
process: 识别传统经典中的合理内核（孟子民贵、礼运天下为公）
在儒家框架内进行最大胆的理论创新
既肯定传统制度的合理成分，又设计制度性限制
通过重新诠释实现传统的创造性转化
modern_applications: 知识传统的创造性发展

modes.name_zh: 万民忧乐法（治乱评判标准）
modes.definition_zh: 黄宗羲提出'天下之治乱，不在一姓之兴亡，而在万民之忧乐'这一振聋发聩的命题，彻底颠覆了传统以王朝兴亡评判治乱的标准。此法将万民的实际生活状态（忧乐）作为评判政治好坏的唯一标准，而不是以政权的存续或君主的品德为依据。在《原臣》篇中，他进一步论证：臣子的职责不是服务于君主个人，而是服务于天下万民。此法是中国古代政治思想中最为接近现代民主评判标准的理论，为后来的革命变革提供了道义基础。
process: 颠覆以王朝兴亡为治乱标准的传统观念
确立万民忧乐为政治质量唯一评判标准
重构臣子职责（服务天下而非君主个人）
以万民实际福祉作为评价一切制度的终极尺度
modern_applications: 以人民为中心的发展观

M301.domain_zh: 政治合法性理论/民本主义
M301.definition_zh: 天下（人民）是政治主体的根本，君主只是天下的客人和服务者。颠覆了'君权神授'的传统逻辑：不是天立君以治民，而是民本位、君末位。'原君'篇指出，君主最初的设立是为了天下人的利益，而非相反。若君主以天下利益为私，则君主身份本身即构成对政治秩序的破坏。
M301.definition_en: Tianxia (the people/world) is the fundamental political subject; the ruler is merely a guest and servant of Tianxia. This subverts the traditional 'divine right' logic: not heaven establishes the ruler to govern the people, but the people are primary and the ruler secondary. The 'Origin of the Ruler' chapter argues the ruler was initially established for the benefit of all under heaven, not the reverse. If the ruler treats Tianxia's interests as private property, the rulership itself constitutes a破坏 of political order.
process_zh: 追溯政治权力的起源：确认权力源于天下公利而非天命授予
区分'公天下'与'私天下'：判断统治者的行为是服务天下还是谋取私利
确立天下（人民）为政治合法性的终极来源
以天下万民的福祉作为评判政治制度优劣的唯一标准
process_en: Trace the origin of political power: confirm it derives from public good rather than heavenly mandate
Distinguish 'public Tianxia' from 'private Tianxia': judge whether governance serves all or merely private interests
Establish Tianxia (the people) as the ultimate source of political legitimacy
Use the well-being of all under heaven as the sole criterion for evaluating political systems
M301.key_quote_zh: 有生之初，人各自私也，人各自利也；天下有公利而莫或兴之，有公害而莫或除之。有人者出，不以一己之利为利，而使天下受其利；不以一己之害为害，而使天下释其害。此其人之勤劳必千万于天下之人。夫以千万倍之勤劳，而己又不享其利，必非天下之人情所欲居也。故古之人君，盍去者也？
M301.key_quote_en: In the beginning of human existence, each person sought their own benefit. When public good arose but none cultivated it, and public harm existed but none removed it, a person emerged who did not treat his own benefit as benefit, but enabled Tianxia to enjoy it; who did not treat his own harm as harm, but freed Tianxia from it. His labor must have been a million times that of ordinary people. Yet he enjoyed no benefit himself—surely no one would naturally seek such a position. Therefore, why should the ancient ruler exist as such?
representative_cases_zh: 《原君》开篇论证君主起源——君主本是替天下人服务的劳苦角色，后世君主却将天下视为私产
对比三代以上'以天下为主'与三代以后'以君为主'的历史退化观

M302.domain_zh: 制度设计理论/治理方法论
M302.definition_zh: 优良制度（治法）优先于个人品德（治人）。与儒家传统'有治人无治法'相反，黄宗羲指出后世的'非法之法'（专制律令）才是真正的祸根，没有好的制度框架，再贤明的君主也无法实现善治。这是中国思想史上首次系统论证制度优先于个人的政治主张。
M302.definition_en: Good institutions (zhi fa) take priority over individual virtue (zhi ren). Contrary to the traditional Confucian claim 'there are governing men but no governing laws,' Huang Zongxi argued that the 'non-law laws' of later ages (despotic ordinances) are the true root of disaster. Without sound institutional frameworks, even the most virtuous ruler cannot achieve good governance. This is the first systematic argument in Chinese intellectual history for institutional priority over individual character.
process_zh: 识别当前制度是'三代以上之法'（公法）还是'一家之法'（私法/非法之法）
分析制度对个人行为的约束与激励结构
判断制度设计是否以天下公利而非一姓私利为出发点
优先改进制度框架而非依赖道德教化或个人修养
process_en: Identify whether current institutions are 'laws of the Three Dynasties' (public law) or 'laws of one family' (private law/non-law)
Analyze how institutional constraints and incentives shape individual behavior
Judge whether institutional design originates from public good rather than dynastic self-interest
Prioritize institutional reform over reliance on moral education or personal cultivation
M302.key_quote_zh: 岂天地之大，于兆人万姓之上，复加一人哉？秦汉以来，对于天下，固以天下为己任；今也以一姓之私，而名曰天下。非法之法，桎梏天下人之手足，岂有治法乎？有治法而后有治人。
M302.key_quote_en: Is it that beyond the great earth and the millions of common people, another person is imposed? Since Qin and Han, rulers have treated Tianxia as their own undertaking; now they treat one family's private interest as Tianxia. These are non-law laws, manacles on the hands and feet of all under heaven—where is there any governing law? Good law must come before good governance by individuals.
representative_cases_zh: 《原法》篇对比三代以上'天下之法'与秦汉以后'一家之法'的本质区别
指出'藏天下于筐箧'的专制制度将国家视为私产
modern_applications_en: Theoretical foundation for rule of law construction

M303.domain_zh: 公共领域理论/协商民主
M303.definition_zh: 学校不应仅是教育机构，更应是政治议政的场所。'必使治天下之具皆出于学校'，学校成为评判是非、议决政策的公共空间。太学祭酒（校长）地位等同宰相，皇帝亦需出席学校参与讨论。这是中国思想史上最接近近代议会制度的构想，将'公其非是于学校'作为制约君权、实现公共理性讨论的制度设计。
M303.definition_en: Schools should not merely be educational institutions but venues for political deliberation. 'All instruments for governing Tianxia must originate from schools.' Schools become public spaces for judging right and wrong and deliberating policy. The Grand Learning's director holds status equivalent to the prime minister, and even the emperor must attend school sessions to participate in discussion. This is the closest conception to a modern parliamentary system in Chinese intellectual history, designing 'public judgment of right and wrong in schools' as an institutional mechanism to check imperial power and realize public rational deliberation.
process_zh: 建立独立于行政体系的学校/学术机构网络
赋予学校评判政治是非的法定权力
使学术领袖（祭酒）具有与行政首脑平等的政治地位
通过学校公开讨论形成公共舆论，制约君主决策
process_en: Establish independent school/academic institution networks separate from the administrative system
Grant schools legal authority to judge political right and wrong
Give academic leaders (director) political status equal to the head of government
Form public opinion through open school deliberations to check imperial decision-making
M303.key_quote_zh: 学校，所以养士也。然古之圣王，其意不仅此也，必使治天下之具皆出于学校，而后设学校之意始备。……是故政教合一如学校，而学校之议不可以不出于天下。
M303.key_quote_en: Schools exist to nurture scholars. But the ancient sage kings' purpose was not limited to this alone—they ensured all instruments for governing Tianxia originated from schools, and only then was the purpose of establishing schools fully realized. ... Therefore when governance and education are integrated as in schools, school deliberations must emerge from the whole world.
representative_cases_zh: 《学校》篇提出太学祭酒'批红'权，皇帝决策须在学校讨论后方可施行
地方学校定期评议地方政务，形成自下而上的舆论监督机制
modern_applications_zh: 学术界与政治界互动机制
独立媒体与公共舆论功能
modern_applications_en: Independent media and public opinion functions

M304.definition_zh: 反对程朱理学'理在气先'的二元论，主张'理即是气之理'，理不能离气而独存。宇宙本原是一气流行，理只是气的运行规律而非独立实体。'盈天地皆心也，变化不测，不能不万殊'，心与气、理与气统一于物质性的气本原。这一立场奠定了明清之际唯物主义哲学的转向。
M304.definition_en: Opposing Cheng-Zhu Neo-Confucian dualism of 'li prior to qi,' arguing 'li is simply the li of qi'; li cannot exist independently apart from qi. The universe's primordial substance is a single qi in flux, and li is merely qi's operational pattern, not an independent entity. 'The whole cosmos is heart-mind, changeful and unpredictable, necessarily diverse'—heart and qi, li and qi are unified in the material primacy of qi. This stance founded the early modern materialist philosophical turn in China.
process_zh: 识别将抽象概念（理/道/太极）实体化的倾向
追溯一切现象的物质基础（气）
确认规律（理）依赖于载体（气）而存在
在气本论基础上重建对世界的理解
process_en: Identify tendencies to reify abstract concepts (li/Dao/taiji) into entities
Trace all phenomena back to their material basis (qi)
Confirm that patterns (li) depend on carriers (qi) for existence
Rebuild understanding of the world on qi-monism foundations
M304.key_quote_zh: 天地间只有一气循环，周流不息，理即在气中，非气外别有理也。
M304.key_quote_en: Between heaven and earth there is only qi cycling endlessly, flowing through all; li exists within qi, there is no separate li outside qi.
representative_cases_zh: 批判朱熹'理先气后'说，指出'若谓理在气先，则是理别为一物矣'
以天文学和历算学研究佐证理气统一观

M305.definition_zh: 真理（一本）通过无数个体化路径（万殊）显现，学术发展不应强求统一标准。编纂《明儒学案》时，黄宗羲主张'有一偏之见，有相反之论，学者于其不同处正宜着眼理会'，反对'以水济水'的同质化。各学派宗旨不同但皆求道，这正是'一本而万殊'的学术生态观。这一方法论突破了'独尊一途'的学术专制传统。
M305.definition_en: Truth (one essence) manifests through countless individualized paths (many manifestations); scholarship should not demand uniform standards. In compiling the 'Ming Ru Xue An,' Huang advocated 'each has partial views and opposing arguments; scholars should pay attention to their differences,' opposing homogenization 'pouring water into water.' Different schools pursue different approaches but all seek the Dao—this is the academic ecology of 'one essence, many manifestations.' This methodology broke through the tradition of 'exclusive devotion to one path' in scholarship.
process_zh: 承认学术传统的多元性：不同学派各有其合理内核
不以单一标准裁剪异见，保留'一偏之见'与'相反之论'
在各家不同处着力理会，从中萃取真理性认识
在多元争鸣中把握统一的学术精神（一本）
process_en: Acknowledge academic tradition's plurality: different schools each contain valid kernels
Do not cut异见 to a single standard; preserve 'partial views' and 'opposing arguments'
Focus on differences among schools to extract truthful insights
Grasp the unifying academic spirit (one essence) amid pluralistic debate
M305.key_quote_zh: 学问之道，以各人自用得着者为真。凡倚门傍户、依样葫芦者，非流俗之士，则经生之业也。此编所列，有一偏之见，有相反之论，学者于其不同处正宜着眼理会，所谓一本而万殊也。以水济水，岂是学问！
M305.key_quote_en: The way of learning is that which each person finds genuinely useful to themselves is true. Those who lean on doors and copy others are either vulgar persons or mere bookworms. What this compilation lists includes partial views and opposing arguments; scholars should focus on their differences—this is what is meant by 'one essence, many manifestations.' Pouring water into water—how can that be scholarship!
representative_cases_zh: 《明儒学案》以王学为主流但不废朱学、陆学诸派，各述宗旨不相贬损
批评孙奇逢《理学宗传》'杂收不复甄别'，主张从全集'纂要钩玄'

M306.definition_zh: 学问的根本目的在于'经世应务'——解决现实社会问题，而非空谈心性。'学必原本于经术而后不为蹈虚，必证明于史籍而后足以应务'，将经学研究与历史考证结合，以史证经、以经驭史，最终服务于治国平天下的实践目标。这是对明代王学末流空疏学风的直接批判。
M306.definition_en: The fundamental purpose of learning is 'practical statecraft'—solving real social problems—not empty contemplation of nature and mind. 'Learning must originate from classical studies to avoid empty vacuity, and must be verified through historical records to be sufficient for practical affairs.' Integrating classical research with historical verification, using history to verify classics and classics to guide history, ultimately serving the practical goal of governing and pacifying the world. This is a direct critique of the vacuous scholarship of late Ming Wang school.
process_zh: 确立学问的最终目的是解决现实问题（应务）
以经学为根基确保理论的正当性来源
以史学为验证工具确保理论的经验基础
将知识生产与社会实践紧密结合
process_en: Establish that learning's ultimate purpose is solving real-world problems
Use classical studies as foundation to ensure theoretical legitimacy
Use historical verification as verification tool to ensure empirical grounding
Tightly integrate knowledge production with social practice
M306.key_quote_zh: 学必原本于经术而后不为蹈虚，必证明于史籍而后足以应务。
M306.key_quote_en: Learning must originate from classical studies to avoid empty vacuity, and must be verified through historical records to be sufficient for practical affairs.
representative_cases_zh: 编撰《明文海》四十余年，保存一代文献以为经世之资
著《明夷待访录》专为解决当时政治制度弊病而作

M307.definition_zh: 以严密的考证方法辨别史料真伪，反对盲从权威和片面记载。'国史取详年月，野史取当是非，家史备官爵世系'，根据不同史料类型确定取舍标准。用天文学推算验证《春秋》日食记录，以历法知识判定古文《尚书》真伪，体现了'实事求是'的实证精神。重视一手材料，反对'谀墓单辞'。
M307.definition_en: Using rigorous verification methods to distinguish authentic from spurious sources, opposing blind deference to authority and selective records. 'Official histories take detailed chronology, unofficial histories take proper judgment of right and wrong, family histories prepare genealogical records'—determining selection criteria by source type. Using astronomical calculations to verify Spring and Autumn Annals eclipse records, applying calendrical knowledge to determine the authenticity of the Old Text Shangshu, embodying the 'seeking truth from facts' empirical spirit. Valuing primary sources, opposing 'flattering epitaphs.'
M307.source_chapter: 《明儒学案》《春秋日食历》《历代甲子考》
process_zh: 区分史料类型：国史、野史、家史各有其功能与局限
对同一事件的不同记载进行交叉比对
运用专门知识（如天文学、历法学）验证历史记录的准确性
汰除传闻之误和爱憎之偏，去伪存真
process_en: Distinguish source types: official, unofficial, and family histories each have functions and limitations
Cross-compare different accounts of the same event
Apply specialized knowledge (astronomy, calendrics) to verify historical record accuracy
Eliminate rumor errors and bias, preserving truth while discarding falsehood
M307.key_quote_zh: 桑海之交，纪事之书杂出，或传闻之误，或爱憎之口，多非事实。以余所见，唯《传信录》、《所知录》、《劫灰录》，庶几与邓光荐之《填海录》可考信不诬。
M307.key_quote_en: At the transition of dynastic change, record-keeping books emerge in a混杂 manner—some from hearsay errors, some from personal favoritism or hostility. Based on my observations, only 'Chuanxin Lu,' 'Suozhi Lu,' and 'Jiehui Lu,' perhaps along with Deng Guangjian's 'Tianhai Lu,' are reliable and not false.
representative_cases_zh: 用西汉三统历和唐代授时历推算春秋日食，验证《春秋》记载的可信度
以历法知识参与阎若璩《尚书古文疏证》的辨伪工作

M308.definition_zh: 税制改革往往导致税负反弹的规律性现象：每次简化税制、合并税种的改革，短期内确实减轻了农民负担，但随后新增名目繁多的附加税又会将负担推到比改革前更高的水平。'积累莫返之害'揭示了制度性腐败的内在逻辑——统治者在税制改革中并非真正让利，而是通过'并税式改革'将隐性剥削合法化后，再叠加新的盘剥。这一规律超越了时代，适用于分析任何制度变革中的利益分配问题。
M308.definition_en: The regular pattern whereby tax reform leads to fiscal burden rebound: each simplification and consolidation reform briefly reduces peasant burdens, but new additional taxes soon drive burdens higher than before reform. 'Accumulated harm that cannot be reversed' reveals the internal logic of institutional corruption—rulers do not genuinely concede benefits in tax reform, but rather legitimize hidden exploitation through 'tax-consolidation reform,' then layer new exactions upon it. This pattern transcends its era and applies to analyzing benefit distribution in any institutional change.
process_zh: 识别税制改革的表层承诺（简并税种、减轻负担）与深层动机
追踪改革前后实际负担的变化轨迹
识别改革中隐藏的'附加'机制：以并税名义取消旧税，再以新名目恢复并加码
预判改革的长期效应，防止'积累莫返'的陷阱
process_en: Identify the surface promises (tax consolidation, burden reduction) versus deep motives of reform
Track actual burden changes before and after reform
Identify hidden 'addition' mechanisms: abolishing old taxes in the name of consolidation, then restoring them with new labels and higher rates
Predict long-term reform effects to avoid the 'irreversible accumulation' trap
M308.key_quote_zh: 以一姓之规，而欲传之永久，莫如并税。……然并税之后，所加又多于并税之前矣。此积累莫返之害也。
M308.key_quote_en: Using one family's regulations hoping to transmit them perpetually—nothing better than tax consolidation. ...Yet after consolidation, what is added exceeds what preceded it. This is the harm of accumulated irreversibility.
representative_cases_zh: 唐代两税法、明代一条鞭法、清代摊丁入亩，每次改革后农民负担均反弹超越改革前
清代秦晖总结命名'黄宗羲定律'，成为分析中国税制史的经典工具

M309.domain_zh: 文化认同理论/民族政治学
M309.domain_en: Cultural Identity Theory / Ethnic Political Science
M309.definition_zh: 以文化（华夏文明）而非种族血统作为区分'华夏'与'夷狄'的标准。'自三代以后，乱天下者无如夷狄矣'，但黄宗羲的'夷夏之辨'并非单纯的种族主义，而是强调文明的先进性与落后性。当夷狄具备文明秩序时，可以接受其统治；当华夏丧失文明时，则等于夷狄。这一文化主义取向使其区别于狭隘的民族主义。
M309.definition_en: Using culture (Chinese civilization) rather than racial lineage as the criterion for distinguishing 'Xia' from 'Yi.' 'Since the Three Dynasties, none has devastated Tianxia more than the Yi and Di,' but Huang's 'Yi-Xia distinction' is not mere racism—it emphasizes the advancement and backwardness of civilization. When the Yi possess civilized order, their rule may be accepted; when Xia loses civilization, it becomes equivalent to Yi. This culturalist orientation distinguishes him from narrow nationalism.
process_zh: 以文化文明程度而非血统种族判断族群归属
在文化沦丧时，本族等于夷狄；在文化进步时，夷狄可入华夏
坚守文化正统，但不陷入种族主义陷阱
将文化传承视为高于政权更替的更高价值
process_en: Judge ethnic belonging by cultural-civilizational level rather than bloodline or race
When culture is lost, one's own people equal Yi; when culture advances, Yi can enter Xia
Uphold cultural orthodoxy without falling into racist traps
Treat cultural transmission as a higher value than regime change
M309.key_quote_zh: 自三代以后，乱天下者无如夷狄矣！
M309.key_quote_en: Since the Three Dynasties, none has devastated Tianxia more than the Yi and Di!
representative_cases_zh: 明亡后终身守节不仕清朝，以'夷夏之辨'为抵抗清廷统治的精神支柱
但同时也承认西方天文学的精密，主张'会通中西之学'

M310.definition_zh: 在尊重各家'一偏之见'的基础上，通过'会众以合一'的归纳方法，从多元学术传统中萃取共同精神。与'一本万殊法'互为表里：一本万殊是分析视角（从共性见差异），会众合一是归纳视角（从差异见共性）。编《明儒学案》时，'皆从全集纂要钩玄'——从每位学者的全集中提炼其宗旨，既不抹杀个性，又揭示共性，实现了'万殊归一本'的学术综合。
M310.definition_en: Respecting each school's 'partial views,' through the inductive method of 'synthesizing the many into one,' extracting shared spirit from diverse academic traditions. Complementary to the 'One Essence Many Manifestations' method: the latter is analytical (seeing difference from commonality), this one is inductive (seeing commonality from difference). In compiling the 'Ming Ru Xue An,' 'from each scholar's complete works, extract the essential threads'—distilling each thinker's core tenets without erasing individuality, yet revealing commonality, achieving the synthesis of 'many manifestations returning to one essence.'
M310.source_chapter: 《明儒学案·发凡》《万充宗墓志铭》
process_zh: 充分收集各学派/各作者的原始文本
从每家全集中提炼核心宗旨（钩玄），不随意删改
在保持各家差异的前提下，寻找贯通的深层结构
将多元认识综合为更高层次的统一理解
process_en: Thoroughly collect original texts from all schools/authors
Extract core tenets from each complete work (钩玄), without arbitrary editing
While preserving differences among schools, find the connecting deep structure
Synthesize pluralistic understanding into a higher-level unified comprehension
M310.key_quote_zh: 士生千载之下，不能会众以合一，由谷而之川，川以达于海，犹可谓之穷经乎？
M310.key_quote_en: A scholar born a thousand years later, unable to synthesize the many into one—from valley to river, from river to sea—can we still call this mastering the classics?
representative_cases_zh: 《明儒学案》六十二卷，涵盖明代近三百年学术流派，每案各自宗旨鲜明，整体又构成统一脉络
批评孙奇逢《理学宗传》'杂收不复甄别'，主张从全集'纂要钩玄'
